mentions.name: Foundational ML paper implementations
mentions.description: A self-study project reimplementing foundational machine learning papers (AlexNet, VGG, Word2Vec, and others) in code, undertaken while working through the Understanding Deep Learning textbook, currently at the CNNs chapter.
mentions.problem: Gaining a deeper understanding of deep learning beyond reading alone.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been wanting to learn deep learning on a deeper level, so I've spent the past month going through Understanding Deep Learning. I've gotten to the chapter on CNNs and right now I'm just implementing a bunch of foundational ML papers (AlexNet, VGG, Word2Vec, etc).
